title: Interior Designer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Protrude Architecture is dedicated to making spaces visually extraordinary through thoughtful and innovative design. The firm delivers comprehensive services including architectural designs, facade designs, interior designs, turnkey interior solutions, and architectural visualizations. By integrating aesthetics with functionality, Protrude Architecture aims to create environments that inspire and serve the needs of clients. Team members collaborate across disciplines to deliver high\\-quality, cohesive design outcomes for a variety of projects.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Interior Designer is a full\\-time, on\\-site role based in Hyderabad. This role involves developing interior design concepts, preparing mood boards, and creating detailed layouts aligned with project requirements and brand standards. Daily responsibilities include space planning, selecting finishes and materials, coordinating FF\\&E (furniture, fixtures, and equipment), and producing drawings and documentation for client presentations and implementation. The Interior Designer will work closely with architects, project managers, and contractors to ensure design intent is maintained through construction and installation. The role also includes site visits, reviewing samples, and collaborating with vendors to achieve project timelines, budgets, and quality expectations.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong Interior Design skills, including concept development and detailing.
* Proficiency in Space Planning to optimize functionality, flow, and user experience.
* Understanding of Architecture and its integration with interior solutions.
* Ability to create accurate Construction Drawings and documentation for execution.
* Experience with FF\\&E selection, specification, and coordination.
* Relevant degree or diploma in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field.
* Proficiency in design and visualization software (e.g., AutoCAD, SketchUp, Revit, 3D visualization tools) and MS Office.
* Strong attention to detail, time management, and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with clients, teams, and vendors.
* Previous experience in residential, commercial, or hospitality interiors in a professional design firm is an advantage.
